title: Detailed top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- brim shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <!-- brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#2d2d5e'/>
  <!-- brim top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74.5' rx='36' ry='7.5' fill='#3f3f7a'/>
  <!-- brim inner highlight rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='27' ry='5.5' fill='#4e4e92'/>
  <!-- crown body -->
  <rect x='28' y='22' width='44' height='54' rx='2' fill='#252550'/>
  <!-- crown left highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='28' y='22' width='8' height='54' rx='2' fill='#363670'/>
  <!-- crown right darker stripe -->
  <rect x='64' y='22' width='8' height='54' rx='2' fill='#1c1c42'/>
  <!-- crown center sheen -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='10' height='54' fill='#2e2e5e'/>
  <!-- crown top ellipse -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#3a3a78'/>
  <!-- crown top inner -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='18' ry='4.5' fill='#2a2a58'/>
  <!-- crown top sheen -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='10' ry='2.5' fill='#4a4a90'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x='28' y='58' width='44' height='10' fill='#b8860b'/>
  <!-- band highlight -->
  <rect x='28' y='58' width='44' height='3' fill='#daa520'/>
  <!-- band dark bottom -->
  <rect x='28' y='65' width='44' height='3' fill='#8b6508'/>
  <!-- band buckle frame -->
  <rect x='40' y='56' width='20' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <!-- buckle inner -->
  <rect x='43' y='58' width='14' height='10' rx='1' fill='#8b6508'/>
  <!-- buckle shine -->
  <rect x='44' y='59' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffe766'/>
  <!-- crown left edge sheen -->
  <rect x='30' y='24' width='3' height='48' fill='#454585' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- crown right edge shade -->
  <rect x='67' y='24' width='3' height='48' fill='#141436' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- brim front highlight -->
  <path d='M 14 77 Q 50 84 86 77 Q 50 80 14 77 Z' fill='#5050a0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- small sparkle on crown -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#8888e0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='1' fill='#8888e0'/>
</svg>
